notes: No VAT in force in Kuwait. Making is usually quoted per gram in KWD (about 3 KWD/g on 21K/22K, 5 KWD/g on 18K) which equals roughly 9% on 22K. Bar premiums use FK Jewellers BTC bar asks vs spot at the KWD peg-basket rate 0.312; only 1-10 g sizes found. Buyback and used-gold discounts not sourced.
